AurelionSol.combo: Chain together an empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → empowered attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → empowered attack. Place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath the airborne opponent to hit them with the delayed explosion as well.
AurelionSol.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Aurelion Sol’s main damage. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, don’t rely on building health alone.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after you make Aurelion Sol use W Astral Flight is your window to engage. If you are caught in Aurelion Sol E Singularity, prioritize getting out of its area over fighting.
AurelionSol.fight: Immediately after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is spent, close the distance with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and fight. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities, and after health has decreased, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
AurelionSol.laning: When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, start a fight before he can build Stardust to slow his scaling. Don’t spend all your mana on the wave; save an ability for trading.
AurelionSol.phase: In the late game, Aurelion Sol’s permanent Stardust scaling is a threat, so don’t expect to find the same engage opportunities.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then follow your allies in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after they engage first. If you steal Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, use it in fights that need area-of-effect crowd control. In a chaotic fight, when health has decreased, land Sylas W Kingslayer to stay in the fight, and spread out from allies to avoid being hit together by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health and builds Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim. When low, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s area, which can execute you; if you get caught, move out immediately. Spread out from allies to avoid being hit together by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Lux.laning: Avoid standing in line with your allies so you aren’t all rooted by Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.build: If you’re often rooted by Lux Q Light Binding before you can get close, get Quicksilver Sash earlier. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lux’s damage, and get movement speed to leave the spot marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.combo: Use an empowered autoattack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → autoattack → Sylas W Kingslayer → autoattack, in that order. Aim so the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash, which explodes after a delay, is positioned under Lux.
Lux.escape: The moment you dodge Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to engage.
Lux.fight: Right after baiting and dodging Lux Q Light Binding, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst’s empowered autoattacks between abilities, and after health has been reduced, hit Lux with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Lux.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and squishiness by looking for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate instead of fighting head-on for too long.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and approach from a different direction so you aren’t all caught by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then enter with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your team engages. If health has been reduced in a messy fight, hit Lux with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive.
Lux.watch: If you’re hit by Lux Q Light Binding, she can follow up with more abilities, so bait it out, dodge, then engage. Don’t stay in Lux E Lucent Singularity, and move sideways when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark. If you’re hit by one of Lux’s abilities, create distance so you don’t get hit by an autoattack that detonates Lux P Illumination’s mark.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and travels faster if it hits something first, so don’t stand on top of an ally. When you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, leave its area. If a transformed opponent approaches, spread out early instead of waiting for the animation. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst and E Tangle-Barbs. If you die after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom hits you, prioritize tenacity. If you get rooted before you can get close and start your combo, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Neeko.combo: Use this sequence: empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → attack.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your window to engage.
Neeko.fight: Immediately after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and force a trade. Hit Neeko with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal after health has been reduced. Fit empowered basic attacks from Sylas P Petricite Burst between skills to add damage.
Neeko.laning: Clear minions with the explosion from Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save the skills you need to trade and Sylas W Kingslayer.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, be careful about engaging head-on because of your short range, and look for a chance to get value from the stolen ultimate.
Neeko.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If an opponent you suspect is Neeko approaches, spread out from your allies so you aren’t all caught by Neeko R Pop Blossom and E Tangle-Barbs. In a skirmish, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer the moment health has been lost to stay alive.

Anivia.escape: If Q hits you, don’t continue the fight; use E’s movement to get out of Anivia R Glacial Storm.
Anivia.fight: After dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost, close the distance with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and fight. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities, and after losing health, hit Anivia with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal. If you can’t break Anivia P Rebirth alone, go in with allies; when she has already used her revive, actively look for a kill.
Anivia.build: Prioritize magic resistance because Anivia’s main damage is magic. If healing from Anivia P Rebirth is enough to erase your trades, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Anivia.combo: Land W after health has decreased during a trade to make use of its healing.
Anivia.laning: Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save an ability for trading and hold Sylas W Kingslayer.
Anivia.phase: In the late game, look for opportunities where a stolen ultimate can be effective instead of fighting head-on for too long.
Anivia.teamfight: Whenever possible, fight in a wide lane where Anivia W Crystallize won’t block your escape. If you have to engage in a narrow path, save Flash. Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then follow your allies in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after they engage first. In a chaotic fight, when health has decreased, land Sylas W Kingslayer to stay in the fight.
Anivia.watch: If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you or you stand in a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals much more damage. If Q hits you, use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to get out of the storm and avoid the next E. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape in narrow paths, so avoid fighting there.

Naafiri.phase: Sylas grows strong in the mid game as he gains ability power and ability haste, but Naafiri’s roams are also most dangerous then, so maintain wide vision. In the late game, group with your team to avoid getting caught alone.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri’s main damage is physical, so build armor and health before magic resistance. If the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate is enough to erase trades, complete one core item, then buy Morellonomicon to reduce her healing.
Naafiri.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Naafiri and use a basic attack. When health has been reduced, finish with Sylas W Kingslayer and a basic attack.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t go in immediately just because only one of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or E Eviscerate is down. Before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes off cooldown, and while her other mobility tools are also down, close the gap with Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct.
Naafiri.fight: Fight by clearing the pack with the area damage from Sylas P Petricite Burst when it reappears right after Naafiri E Eviscerate. Use Sylas W Kingslayer on Naafiri to heal after health has been reduced, and wait to use it while Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active.
Naafiri.laning: Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions while saving the skills and mana you need to trade. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers applies a bleed, create distance.
Naafiri.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Clear Naafiri’s pack with Sylas P Petricite Burst, and heal with Sylas W Kingslayer if health has been reduced. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit may become available again, so fall back to avoid getting caught in succession.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies a bleed, create distance until it ends to avoid the second Q and the pack’s damage. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she cannot be targeted, so save Sylas W Kingslayer. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit dashes to a targeted champion, so don’t go alone while her ultimate is available.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang extends its range each time it hits a minion, so don’t stand behind the wave to block it; dodge both passes. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage or escape, and its cooldown resets when he gets a takedown. If you are low when Akshan R Comeuppance starts aiming, don’t flee alone in the open; hide behind terrain.
Akshan.teamfight: Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies go in first. In a skirmish, after losing health, hit an enemy champion, including Akshan, with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal. If you have a villain mark after killing one of Akshan’s allies, avoid facing Akshan alone or staying within his execute range.
Akshan.build: Prioritize armor because Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance deal most of their damage as physical damage. Basic attacks and attack speed also matter to Akshan’s damage, so consider ways to reduce his attack speed.
Akshan.combo: Use a Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Akshan, then attack. If health has decreased, hit Akshan with Sylas W Kingslayer and follow with another empowered attack.
Akshan.escape: Akshan E Heroic Swing is his main mobility tool, so right after you bait it out is your window to engage with Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If Akshan is in an open area where he has difficulty using a wall, he will also have a harder time disengaging.
Akshan.fight: Bait out Akshan E Heroic Swing, then close the distance with Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. After health has decreased, hit Akshan with Sylas W Kingslayer to make use of its healing, and weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities.
Akshan.laning: Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save one cast for trading and hold Sylas W Kingslayer. Akshan Q Avengerang can extend when it hits minions, so watch its path even from behind the wave.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, choose fights where a stolen ultimate can get value instead of engaging first head-on.

TwistedFate.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, W Pick a Card, and E Stacked Deck. Armor won’t help you withstand this opponent’s damage.
TwistedFate.combo: Use this sequence: empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → empowered attack → Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been lost → empowered attack.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card consumes its gold card is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.fight: Right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer. Fit empowered attacks from Sylas P Petricite Burst between skills, then hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal after health has been lost.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions while saving the skills and mana you need for a fight.
TwistedFate.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and low durability, and look for a chance to get value from your stolen ultimate instead of diving in first from the front.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If Twisted Fate has spent his gold card, close in immediately afterward and target him. If you see the teleport from Twisted Fate R Destiny within range, interrupt it with the disruption from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In a skirmish, land Sylas W Kingslayer when health has been lost to stay alive.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a gold card, one attack will stun you, so stay out of his attack range.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, her Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you’re poisoned, so step out of range, then re-engage. You can’t use mobility abilities like Sylas W Kingslayer or Sylas E Abscond / Abduct inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so go around without stepping into the cloud. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Finish one core item first. If Cassiopeia E Twin Fang heals enough to erase your trades, fit Morellonomicon into your build next. All of Cassiopeia’s damaging abilities deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance when building defenses.
Cassiopeia.combo: After an empowered basic attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Cassiopeia and attack again. After health has decreased, hit her with Sylas W Kingslayer and finish with an empowered attack.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze comes out, turn away to avoid the stun, then decide whether to continue the engage. Don’t approach while Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast has poisoned you; wait for the poison to end.
Cassiopeia.fight: Engage before Cassiopeia W Miasma is placed or right after it is used elsewhere, from an angle where you can land the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, back off until the poison ends. After health has decreased during a trade, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Cassiopeia.laning: Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions, but save mana for trades and keep Sylas W Kingslayer available.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia’s damage over time is threatening later on, so don’t fight her head-on for long. Find a position where the ultimate you stole can make an impact.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Steal an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack before a fight, then follow your allies’ engage as the second one in. Use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to knock up and catch Cassiopeia when Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere or when you can cut off her movement path. In the team fight, land Sylas W Kingslayer to heal as soon as health drops, and turn away when you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.

Vex.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of Vex’s telegraphed area attacks. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Vex’s damage, and get tenacity in case you have to move without a dash.
Vex.escape: The moment after Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s Doom has been used is your window to engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If Vex W Personal Space is also down or Vex can’t use Vex R Shadow Surge, she’ll have trouble creating distance, so close in with Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct.
Vex.fight: Engage after Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s Doom has been used and Vex W Personal Space’s shield is down.
Vex.laning: Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions, but save enough mana to trade, and look for an opening right after Vex uses Doom on the wave.
Vex.teamfight: Before the fight, secure an ultimate to steal with Sylas R Hijack, then use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to enter second after your allies start their engage. Move low-health allies out of range of Vex R Shadow Surge first to prevent Vex from getting the first takedown that would reset her ultimate. In a chaotic fight, use Sylas W Kingslayer to heal when your health drops and stay alive.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s Doom is active, fear can interrupt Sylas E Abscond / Abduct or the dash on Sylas W Kingslayer, so delay your engage. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so dodge with a short sidestep when it’s in range. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits and marks you, move toward your allies so you can take Vex’s dash together.
Vex.combo: Then use Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → empowered attack → Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been lost → empowered attack.
Vex.phase: In the late game, account for Sylas’s short range and squishiness and look for a situation where a stolen ultimate will be valuable instead of engaging head-on.

Ahri.build: Prioritize a way to interrupt or cleanse Ahri E Charm, and build magic resistance against Ahri’s magic damage. Magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return. If healing from Ahri P Essence Theft is enough to erase your trades, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Ahri.combo: Chain together an empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → attack. Place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Ahri to hit her with the delayed explosion as well.
Ahri.escape: Engage right after dodging Ahri E Charm, especially while Ahri R Spirit Rush is also down.
Ahri.fight: Close the distance after dodging Ahri E Charm or immediately after Ahri uses it. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer make it easier to stick to her. After health has decreased during a trade, hit Ahri with Sylas W Kingslayer to make use of its healing.
Ahri.laning: Early on, keep minions between you and Ahri to dodge Ahri E Charm. Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save enough mana to trade. After learning Sylas R Hijack, push the lane and join fights in other lanes or around objectives.
Ahri.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and squishy body when looking for opportunities to get value from a stolen ultimate.
Ahri.teamfight: Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then follow up as the second entrant with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies start engaging. When Ahri E Charm is down, look for a chance to catch her, and keep in mind that Ahri R Spirit Rush and Ahri W Fox-Fire can create distance. In a chaotic fight, the moment health decreases, hit Ahri with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay in the fight.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you may take the full follow-up, so dodge it by moving behind minions. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return as well, so keep moving out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Akali.build: Sylas’s magic damage is easily blocked by Akali’s high magic resistance, so prioritize magic penetration. Build magic resistance and health to prepare for the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution instead of stacking armor.
Akali.combo: Place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Akali while she is airborne.
Akali.escape: Dodge the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip, then engage after Akali W Twilight Shroud and R Perfect Execution have both been spent. If only one mobility tool has been spent, she can escape with the remaining tools, so look for an opening especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up.
Akali.fight: After health has decreased during a trade, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal, and weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities.
Akali.laning: Clear minions with the explosion from Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save one cast for trading. Hold Sylas W Kingslayer to sustain in lane.
Akali.phase: In the late game, look for opportunities to get value from a stolen ultimate instead of fighting head-on for too long.
Akali.teamfight: Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, preferably one that provides area-of-effect crowd control or helps you engage. After your allies engage, follow up as the second entrant with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If health decreases in a chaotic fight, land Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay in the fight.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits and marks you, the second dash follows you to wherever you escape. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so save Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to respond while Akali is on top of you.

Ambessa.build: Complete one core item first. If Ambessa’s healing is enough to erase your trades, fit Morellonomicon in next. When building resistance against her physical damage, choose armor while accounting for the penetration on Ambessa R Public Execution and the maximum-health damage from Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam.
Ambessa.combo: Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities, and land Sylas W Kingslayer after health has decreased.
Ambessa.escape: Engage right after Ambessa uses her abilities and spends the charge from Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step.
Ambessa.fight: Counterattack right after Ambessa spends her abilities and the empowered attack charge from Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step. If health decreases during the trade, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Ambessa.laning: After learning Sylas R Hijack, push the lane and join fights in other lanes or around objectives.
Ambessa.phase: In the late game, Sylas can struggle in head-on fights, so look for opportunities to get value from a stolen ultimate.
Ambessa.teamfight: Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then follow up as the second entrant with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies engage first. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a line, so don’t stand in a straight line with your back line. In a chaotic fight, the moment health decreases, land Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay in the fight.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup from Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and leave its area. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a line and is unstoppable, so don’t stand in a straight line with your back line while facing off against her.

Annie.build: Annie’s damage is magic, so prioritize enough magic resistance to withstand her burst. Annie R Summon: Tibbers has penetration, so don’t rely on resistance alone; also consider movement speed to get out of its area.
Annie.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Annie and attack, followed by Sylas W Kingslayer and an attack when health has decreased to finish the sequence.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie has just used Annie P Pyromania’s stun is your chance to engage.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities, and after health has decreased, hit Annie with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Annie.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and weak survivability when looking for opportunities to get value from a stolen ultimate.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready or Annie is out of sight, avoid clumping with allies to guard against the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies go in first. In a chaotic fight, when health has decreased, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to stay in the fight.
Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so stay out of her ability range.

Aurora.build: Complete one core item first. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Q Twofold Hex, and E The Weirding. If Aurora’s healing is enough to erase your trades, fit Morellonomicon in after your core item.
Aurora.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Aurora, attack, use Sylas W Kingslayer after health has decreased, then attack again. Weave attacks between abilities to use Sylas P Petricite Burst’s charge in the trade.
Aurora.escape: The moment Aurora has used both W Across the Veil and E The Weirding is Sylas’s chance to engage. If only one is down, she can escape with the other mobility tool, so account for Aurora R Between Worlds too, and especially look for an opening before that ultimate comes back up.
Aurora.fight: After Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are down, close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If health has fallen enough to make Aurora Q Twofold Hex’s recall damage substantial, break off the trade.
Aurora.laning: Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save mana for trading and hold Sylas W Kingslayer for sustain.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and squishy body when choosing fights where a stolen ultimate can be effective.
Aurora.teamfight: Before a fight, use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate, then follow your allies in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after they engage first. If Aurora engages with her leap but gets no takedown, look to catch her before she can leap again. In a chaotic fight, when health has decreased, land Sylas W Kingslayer to stay in the fight, and don’t leave a low-health ally behind when you retreat.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it damages you again when recalled, and the recall damage increases the more health you have lost. If you are cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and if you are low, retreat before the recall. While Aurora is invisible with W Across the Veil, hold your targeted abilities and wait for her to reappear.

Azir.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the telegraphed soldier attack range. Build magic resistance rather than armor to reduce Azir’s damage.
Azir.combo: Then place Sylas Q Chain Lash so its intersection explodes under Azir and land a basic attack. After taking damage, hit him with Sylas W Kingslayer and attack again to get healing and passive damage.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir uses E Shifting Sands, look to close the gap with Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back your engage, so don’t enter together in a group through narrow corridors.
Azir.fight: After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves a soldier, make a short engage while it stands still. If you let Azir go, you’ll keep taking soldier attacks, so focus your damage as soon as you catch him.
Azir.laning: After learning Sylas R Hijack, push the lane and join fights in other lanes or around objectives.
Azir.phase: Azir is strong in extended fights later on, so don’t fight him head-on for long. Make an impact in short skirmishes with the ultimate you stole.
Azir.teamfight: Use Sylas R Hijack to secure an ultimate before a fight. Enter from multiple directions in open terrain so Azir R Emperor's Divide can’t knock multiple allies back, and use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to follow your allies’ engage. If health decreases in a chaotic fight, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Azir.watch: Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his sand soldiers and slows. After a soldier moves, avoid the line it stands on and circle around to approach Azir. In narrow corridors, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back everyone entering together, so don’t group up there.

Corki.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and R Missile Barrage. Consider health as well, since resistance cannot block the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions. Getting out of Corki E Gatling Gun’s range takes priority over building more resistance.
Corki.combo: Chain together an empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → basic attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → basic attack. Aim for Q’s delayed intersection to land under Corki while he is knocked up.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses W Valkyrie, there is an engage window while his movement ability is unavailable, so close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, he can escape over terrain, so don’t force an engage.
Corki.fight: Look to engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct right after Corki W Valkyrie is used. Fight from outside the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun, and after health has decreased, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki and cut off his farming with ganks during his weak first five levels, but save Sylas Q Chain Lash for trades.
Corki.phase: Later on, Corki gets stronger while firing missiles from a safe position, while Sylas struggles in head-on fights. Find a position where your stolen ultimate can make an impact.
Corki.teamfight: Steal an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack before a fight, then enter as the second one in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies engage. If you stole Corki R Missile Barrage, use its splash damage around the first target hit. In the team fight, land Sylas W Kingslayer to heal as soon as health drops and stay alive.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one hit, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition to avoid repeatedly getting hit by every third missile. If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, it reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him.

Diana.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the telegraphed attack range. Build magic resistance to reduce Diana’s damage.
Diana.combo: Land an empowered attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Diana, then attack. When health has decreased, hit her with Sylas W Kingslayer and finish with an empowered attack.
Diana.escape: Engage right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark from Q Crescent Strike on her target. Catch her then with the slow from Sylas Q Chain Lash or the knockup from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If you are marked instead, create distance in anticipation of her re-engaging.
Diana.fight: Start a trade after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down. If Diana engages with E Lunar Rush without a mark from Q Crescent Strike, slow her with Sylas Q Chain Lash, then knock her up and catch her with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. After health has decreased, hit her with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Diana.phase: Sylas is strong in the mid game as he gains ability haste and ability power. Later on, find a position where your stolen ultimate can make an impact instead of engaging head-on.
Diana.teamfight: Space out from your allies based on Diana R Moonfall’s engage angle, and secure vision on the flanks so she can’t pull several of you in. Secure an ultimate with Sylas R Hijack before a fight, then follow your allies’ engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If health drops in the team fight, use Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it travels, so dodge to the side. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush resets, so use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to leave the area. Don’t approach right after Diana activates W Pale Cascade; wait for the orbs and shield to disappear.

Ekko.build: Finish one core item first. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s main damage. If Ekko R Chronobreak heals enough to erase your trades, fit Morellonomicon into your build after your core item.
Ekko.combo: Chain together an empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → basic attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → basic attack.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don’t force an engage. After both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, close the gap with Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct.
Ekko.fight: After health has decreased, hit Ekko with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and turn the trade around. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase deep just because health is low.
Ekko.laning: Use the explosion from Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions, but save an opportunity to trade and keep Sylas W Kingslayer available.
Ekko.phase: Later on, account for your short range and low durability. Find a position where your stolen ultimate can make an impact instead of engaging head-on.
Ekko.teamfight: Steal an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack before a fight, then go in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies engage. Right after Ekko uses E Phase Dive to engage, look for a chance to interrupt his movement with the knockup from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If health drops in the chaotic fight, hit Ekko with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive.
Ekko.watch: When you see the cast signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and dodge its return path too. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if health is low.

Fizz.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Fizz W Seastone Trident, E Playful / Trickster, and R Chum the Waters. Armor does nothing to reduce this damage. Keep an eye on your distance so you can dodge Fizz’s first engage spell while building resistance.
Fizz.combo: Then use Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attack → Q Chain Lash → empowered attack → W Kingslayer → empowered attack.
Fizz.escape: Look for an opportunity to engage right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.
Fizz.fight: Look to counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, and account for the movement from his Q Urchin Strike if he still has it when you engage. Right after Fizz applies W Seastone Trident, knock him up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. After health has decreased, hit him with W Kingslayer to heal and trade.
Fizz.laning: Use Q Chain Lash to clear minions, but save one cast for a trade. Look to trade after Fizz misses a last hit with a W Seastone Trident empowered attack or uses E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.phase: Later on, account for your short range and low durability; don’t be the first to dive in head-on.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies and make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then attack together. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Before a fight, secure an ultimate with Sylas R Hijack, then join with E Abscond / Abduct after your allies engage and stay alive with W Kingslayer when health has decreased.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used for both engaging and escaping, so don’t use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct carelessly before Fizz E is down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. If Fizz uses Q Urchin Strike to follow the shark’s knockup, respond along his path with the slow from Sylas Q Chain Lash or the knockup from E Abscond / Abduct.

Galio.build: Prioritize magic penetration over building more ability power for offense. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Galio’s damage, and avoid stacking only health since Galio Q Winds of War scales with your maximum health.
Galio.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Galio and land a basic attack. When health has decreased, hit him with Sylas W Kingslayer and finish with a basic attack.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Dodge the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand, and close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer especially before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back up.
Galio.fight: Stop trading and leave taunt range while Galio charges W Shield of Durand. After Galio’s crowd control is down, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and fight. After health has decreased, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Galio.laning: If Galio uses his abilities on the wave and spends mana, clear the lane with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save abilities for a trade.
Galio.phase: Later on, account for your short range and low durability; choose a position where your stolen ultimate can make a clear impact.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don’t start a small skirmish against Galio’s team in another lane. Before a team fight, secure the ultimate you need with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your allies’ engage as the second one in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Move out of the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, and use Sylas W Kingslayer to heal if health drops during the fight.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges W Shield of Durand, he takes reduced damage and the taunt lasts longer, so don’t dump your damage; leave taunt range. Avoid the point where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. Watch for Galio E Justice Punch’s windup as he steps back and dodge it, and immediately leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.

Hwei.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Hwei’s damage. If immobilizing crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment catches you before you can engage and stops your combo, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier. Also consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed ranges.
Hwei.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Hwei and chain a basic attack, Sylas W Kingslayer, and another basic attack.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability to create distance, so engage when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If that ability is still available, it can interrupt your engage with a root or forced movement, so wait.
Hwei.fight: Close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities, and after damage has been taken and health has decreased, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Hwei.laning: Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions, but save abilities for a trade and keep Sylas W Kingslayer available. Watch for the eye Hwei leaves behind; when calling for a gank, take another route or use minions and other objects to consume the eye first.
Hwei.phase: Later on, account for your short range and low durability. Find a position where your stolen ultimate can make an impact.
Hwei.teamfight: Steal an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack before a fight, then enter after your allies engage. Once Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, approach with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer. In the team fight, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer as soon as health drops to stay alive.
Hwei.watch: If you’re rooted by Hwei E Subject: Torment or hit by forced movement, you can take the damage that follows, so don’t dive in first while this ability is available. If the first spell hits you, reposition immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Watch out for the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair and the maximum-health damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster as well.

Irelia.combo: Use an empowered autoattack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Irelia, then autoattack. When health has decreased, hit her with Sylas W Kingslayer and finish with an autoattack. Expend Sylas P Petricite Burst’s empowered autoattacks between each ability.
Irelia.escape: Immediately after you’ve baited out Irelia Q Bladesurge, you have a chance to close the gap with Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct.
Irelia.fight: Approach with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down. Sylas’s magic damage hits Irelia hard because she tends to have low magic resistance.
Irelia.laning: Irelia can approach with Irelia Q Bladesurge through low-health minions, so back away when minions are close to dying. Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save the abilities you need for trades and Sylas W Kingslayer.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, account for Sylas’s short range and weak survivability by looking for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia before she splits the fight with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and stuns multiple champions with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack before the fight, then enter with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your team engages. If health decreases, use Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive in the fight.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Leaving the zone through the blades deals bonus damage and heavily slows you.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance first to deal with the magic damage from Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma W Focused Resolve is enough to erase your trades, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item. If you’re often stopped by a root as soon as you engage, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Karma.combo: Next, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Karma, then autoattack. When health has decreased, finish with Sylas W Kingslayer and an autoattack.
Karma.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended.
Karma.fight: Close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended. Sylas’s magic damage hits Karma hard because she has low magic resistance, so trade when you can get on her. After health has been reduced, hit Karma with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Karma.laning: If you keep getting hit by Karma’s abilities, Karma R Mantra comes back sooner, so move behind minions or out of her range.
Karma.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and squishiness by looking for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate instead of engaging head-on.
Karma.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. First bait out Karma W Focused Resolve, then wait for the shield from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma E Inspire to end. Follow your team’s engage as the second one in. In a messy fight, hit with Sylas W Kingslayer as soon as health has been reduced to heal and stay alive.
Karma.watch: Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma Q Inner Flame leaves a zone that explodes again, so if you’re hit, move outside it immediately. If you stay connected to Karma W Focused Resolve, you’ll be rooted, so create distance to break the tether. Delay your engage right after Karma E Inspire grants its shield and movement speed.

Kassadin.build: Build ability power and ability haste first to strengthen your midgame fights. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kassadin’s ability damage. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, not health, so don’t buy Grievous Wounds to counter him.
Kassadin.combo: Then use Sylas P Petricite Burst’s empowered autoattack, Sylas Q Chain Lash, an autoattack, Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been reduced, and another autoattack, in that order. Weave autoattacks between abilities and place Q so its intersection explodes under Kassadin.
Kassadin.escape: If Kassadin has used R repeatedly, check his mana and punish him when he runs out of mana to move.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to knock him up, then place the delayed explosion of Sylas Q Chain Lash under him. After health has been reduced, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and keep trading.
Kassadin.laning: Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save mana for trades and avoid unnecessary ability use near Kassadin.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin can exploit Sylas’s short range and weakness in head-on fights, so don’t stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then enter with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your team engages. Kassadin can use Kassadin R Riftwalk to reach your backline, so don’t stand alone away from your team. In a messy fight, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer as soon as health has been reduced to heal and stay alive.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Sylas’s magic damage, so trade after Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. Spamming abilities near Kassadin reduces the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse.

Leblanc.build: LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, W Distortion, and E Ethereal Chains all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Consider a spell shield to block combos that start with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice. If you’re rooted before you can get close and start a fight, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Leblanc.combo: Then use an empowered autoattack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → autoattack → Sylas W Kingslayer → autoattack, in that order.
Leblanc.escape: LeBlanc W Distortion is her mobility tool, so your chance to close the gap comes immediately after forcing her to use it.
Leblanc.fight: Close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has already been used. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst’s empowered autoattacks between abilities.
Leblanc.laning: Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save the abilities and mana you need for trades.
Leblanc.phase: In the late game, look for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate instead of prolonging a head-on fight.
Leblanc.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. Follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct as the second one in. In a messy fight, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer as soon as health has been reduced to heal and stay alive.
Leblanc.watch: If you’re marked by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, her next ability deals more damage, so back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image makes her appear in two places, check which one is actually attacking before using abilities.

Lissandra.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lissandra’s damage. If you’re stopped by a root as soon as you engage, get Quicksilver Sash earlier. If Lissandra’s healing is enough to erase your trades, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Lissandra.combo: Use an empowered autoattack, Sylas Q Chain Lash, an autoattack, Sylas W Kingslayer, and another autoattack, in that order.
Lissandra.escape: Even after Lissandra has used E and finished moving, close the gap with Sylas’s mobility if Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. After Lissandra uses E Glacial Path, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer. After health has been reduced, hit Lissandra with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Lissandra.laning: Early on, stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save the abilities and mana you need for trades.
Lissandra.phase: In the late game, look for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate, since engaging head-on is difficult.
Lissandra.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then enter with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your team engages. Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been fully spent before deciding to engage. In a messy fight, hit Lissandra with Sylas W Kingslayer when health has been reduced to stay alive.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a line with allied minions. If you’re rooted by Lissandra W Ring of Frost or stunned by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, it’s hard to deal damage after engaging. When Lissandra can cast R on herself, spread out your attacks so they don’t land during her stasis.

Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, W Void Swarm, and E Malefic Visions. If you need to deal with the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp, prepare Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. His ultimate deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on choices that only greatly increase your health.
Malzahar.combo: Then use an empowered autoattack, hit Malzahar with Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been reduced, and follow with another empowered autoattack. If Q can be used again during the fight, time it with a slow or knockup so the intersection explodes under Malzahar.
Malzahar.escape: Engage after dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void and removing Malzahar P Void Shift. If Voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already on the field, clear them first with area damage such as Sylas P Petricite Burst, then close the gap.
Malzahar.fight: While Malzahar P Void Shift is active, first remove it with Sylas Q Chain Lash, then enter from an angle where Sylas E Abscond / Abduct can knock him up. A good opening is when Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and there are no Voidlings from W Void Swarm. After damage has been exchanged and health has been reduced, hit Malzahar with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Malzahar.laning: If Malzahar pushes the lane, first remove Malzahar P Void Shift and look for a chance to catch him with your jungler.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, while Sylas struggles in late-game head-on fights, so look for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate.
Malzahar.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In a messy fight, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer as soon as health has been reduced to heal and stay alive longer.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so don’t go for last hits next to that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the two portals and engage after the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp can’t be removed with Sylas’s mobility, so don’t enter an area without vision alone while Malzahar can cast his ultimate.

Mel.build: Mel’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance. If you’re often rooted as soon as you engage or the enemy composition also has many ways to immobilize you, get Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Mel.combo: Use an empowered autoattack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Mel, then autoattack. After health has been reduced, close in with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal, then autoattack again.
Mel.escape: Your chance to engage comes after dodging the root from Mel E Solar Snare to the side and Mel W Rebuttal is down.
Mel.fight: Sylas’s magic damage hits Mel hard because she has low magic resistance, so dodge Mel W Rebuttal and E Solar Snare, then close the gap and trade. Make use of Sylas W Kingslayer’s healing by hitting Mel after damage has reduced health. Expend empowered autoattacks between abilities during trades.
Mel.laning: Clear minions with Sylas Q Chain Lash, but save the abilities and mana you need for trades. Apply pressure when you have a chance to slow Mel’s growth.
Mel.phase: In the late game, Mel’s scaling adds up and Sylas gets weaker in head-on fights, so look for a chance to get value from a stolen ultimate.
Mel.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then enter as the second one in after your team engages, using Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. When Mel W Rebuttal activates, don’t rush your chains or Sylas Q Chain Lash. If health has been reduced in a messy fight, hit Mel with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive.
Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles briefly, so be careful when using Sylas Q Chain Lash and the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you’re hit in the center, making it easy to get hit by Mel Q Radiant Volley next, so dodge it to the side. If you’ve been hit by poke several times, watch out for Mel P Searing Brilliance’s execute even if you still have health. While stacks of Overwhelm remain, assume Mel R Golden Eclipse can reach you from far away.

Orianna.build: Orianna’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor. Movement speed also helps you leave areas Orianna has covered with her abilities.
Orianna.combo: After an empowered attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Orianna and attack again. When health has been lost, land Sylas W Kingslayer, then finish with an empowered attack.
Orianna.escape: Engage when Orianna Q Command: Attack has moved the ball away from her and she has already used the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance or the forced movement from Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Orianna.fight: Trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her. She won’t have the sustained defensive stats from Orianna E Command: Protect, so look for an angle to close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. After health has been lost, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Orianna.phase: In the late game, look for a chance to get value from your stolen ultimate instead of fighting head-on for too long.
Orianna.teamfight: Check the ball’s position before Orianna’s, and avoid areas reached by Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Before a fight, secure an ultimate with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If health has been lost in a skirmish, use Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive.
Orianna.watch: Position yourself according to the location of the ball moved by Orianna Q Command: Attack. Avoid the area around it, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Also watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and repeated attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Qiyana.build: Build armor first against Qiyana’s main damage. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid options that add a large amount of health alone. If a root keeps you from using your combo as soon as you engage, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Qiyana.combo: Then cast Sylas Q Chain Lash so it overlaps beneath Qiyana, followed by an attack, Sylas W Kingslayer, and another attack. Use attacks between skills to consume Sylas P Petricite Burst.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t rush in when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, since she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Wait until both of her movement abilities are down and you’ve dodged the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer.
Qiyana.fight: Fight after Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity are down, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up. If Qiyana uses her combo and remains in front, counterattack by closing in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Hit Qiyana with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal after damage has been taken and health has been lost.
Qiyana.phase: In the late game, Qiyana becomes relatively weaker, but Sylas can also struggle in head-on fights. Stay away from terrain, move with your team, and look for a chance to use your stolen ultimate.
Qiyana.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If you stole Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, use it where its shockwave can detonate against terrain. Even when grouped with your team, stay away from walls and narrow paths so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent doesn’t hit you all together. Heal with Sylas W Kingslayer when health has been lost.
Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches with river element, move out of range of the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears with brush element, move into your team’s vision. When health is below half, create distance from Qiyana while she has rock element. Don’t stand with your back to a wall where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can knock you into it; if it hits, use Sylas E Abscond / Abduct to move away from the terrain.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If you’re often rooted before you can engage, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier, and consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Ryze.fight: Close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after dodging Ryze E Spell Flux or after Ryze W Rune Prison is down.
Ryze.laning: Ryze also lacks mana and damage early, so trade after dodging Ryze E Spell Flux to pressure his scaling.
Ryze.phase: In the late game, look for a chance to get value from your stolen ultimate instead of fighting head-on for too long.
Ryze.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage and get on Ryze with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In a skirmish, land Sylas W Kingslayer the moment health has been lost to stay alive.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, the following Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload is empowered. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. If you’re marked, move away from allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears.

Syndra.build: Buy boots early to get the movement speed needed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, and E Scatter the Weak on foot. Prioritize magic resistance, but also watch your total health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Syndra and weave in attacks. When health has been lost, finish with Sylas W Kingslayer and an attack.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to engage.
Syndra.fight: Right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, look for an angle to close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. After taking damage, hit Syndra with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and keep trading.
Syndra.phase: In the late game, account for your short range and low durability, avoid engaging head-on, and look for a chance to get value from your stolen ultimate.
Syndra.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Avoid areas covered by many Syndra Q Dark Spheres. If health has been lost in a skirmish, land Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive.
Syndra.watch: Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push a sphere and stun you, so if you see a sphere between you and Syndra, move out of its line. Move away from areas covered by multiple Syndra Q Dark Sphere, where Syndra R Unleashed Power can deal more damage.

Talon.build: Talon deals physical damage, so buy cheap armor such as Cloth Armor early. If Talon builds flat penetration, get both armor and health. Talon tends to have high magic resistance, so consider magic penetration when increasing your damage.
Talon.combo: Then place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash beneath Talon, followed by an attack, Sylas W Kingslayer, and another attack. Land Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been lost to get the heal as well.
Talon.escape: The moment after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is used is your window to engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If you confirm that Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, it’s an even better time to counterattack.
Talon.fight: Right after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is used, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer. Fight while avoiding the return path of Talon W Rake, and hit Talon with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal after health has been lost.
Talon.phase: Talon’s influence drops in the late game, but Sylas is also weak in head-on fights, so choose carefully where to use your stolen ultimate.
Talon.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, then follow your team’s engage with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If Talon dives into your backline, group with your team and catch him with the knockup from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In a skirmish, land Sylas W Kingslayer the moment health has been lost to heal and stay alive.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on both the way out and back, it stacks Talon P Blade's End, so if the first hit lands, move out of its return path. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can escape with stealth, so don’t chase too hard.

Veigar.build: All of Veigar’s damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Move speed is more valuable for getting out of telegraphed areas like Veigar W Dark Matter, so build it first.
Veigar.combo: Then use an empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → empowered attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → empowered attack.
Veigar.escape: The opportunity to engage comes after Veigar uses Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.fight: When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer. After health has been lost during a trade, hit a champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal, and keep moving to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions so Veigar Q Baleful Strike doesn’t hit you unnecessarily and give him stacking growth. Use the explosion from Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions while saving the skills and mana you need to trade.
Veigar.phase: In the late game, Veigar’s permanent stacks from Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power make the matchup increasingly unfavorable, so don’t fight him head-on for long.
Veigar.teamfight: Before a fight, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon, and secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack in advance. Wait for an ally to engage, then follow up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In a skirmish, use Sylas W Kingslayer to heal when health has been lost, but if health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns when you cross its edge. If you’re trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move around within it and wait for it to disappear. Dodge Veigar W Dark Matter to the side when you see the ground marker, and if health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on missing health.

Viktor.build: Viktor Q Siphon Power, E Hextech Ray, and R Arcane Storm all deal magic damage, so consider magic resistance before armor. Also get move speed to escape the areas of Viktor W Gravity Field and R Arcane Storm.
Viktor.combo: Place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Viktor so the delayed explosion also hits. If Viktor W Gravity Field appears, don’t insist on finishing your combo inside it; get out.
Viktor.escape: The window to engage opens after Viktor W Gravity Field is down.
Viktor.fight: Close the gap when Viktor W Gravity Field is down or you can dodge it. Account for the shield and move speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power by weaving Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between skills, and trade by healing with Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been lost.
Viktor.laning: Stand at an angle to the wave to dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray. Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions, but save the mana and skills you need to trade. Look for a chance to pressure Viktor early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up.
Viktor.phase: In the late game, avoid fighting a scaled Viktor head-on and look for a situation where a stolen ultimate will be valuable.
Viktor.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. After your allies engage, follow up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Stick to Viktor, who has no dash, while staying out of Viktor W Gravity Field. When health has been reduced, heal with Sylas W Kingslayer and stay alive.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the minion wave; dodge to the side. Standing in Viktor W Gravity Field will stun you, so escape with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct as soon as it appears and stop trading while you’re inside it.

Vladimir.build: Build magic resistance early against Vladimir’s damage. Liandry’s Torment is effective against Vladimir, who builds health. If Vladimir’s healing is negating your trades after you complete your first core item, fit in Morellonomicon.
Vladimir.combo: Use an empowered attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under the enemy, then attack again. If health has been reduced, hit them with Sylas W Kingslayer and finish with an attack.
Vladimir.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down.
Vladimir.fight: You can close the gap while Vladimir is slowed as he charges E Tides of Blood. After health has been reduced, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and keep trading.
Vladimir.phase: In the late game, look for a situation where a stolen ultimate will be valuable instead of fighting head-on.
Vladimir.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. After your allies engage, follow up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Don’t group with your allies inside the area of Vladimir R Hemoplague; if you’re infected, rejoin after the effect ends. In a skirmish, hit the target with Sylas W Kingslayer the moment health is reduced to stay alive.
Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, stand behind minions or move out of its range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague infects you, you’ll take increased damage, so step back until the effect ends.

Xerath.build: For your first purchase, prioritize a way to remove or cleanse the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Afterward, build magic resistance against Xerath’s magic damage and move speed to get out of his telegraphed attack areas.
Xerath.combo: Use an empowered attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Xerath, then attack. While health is reduced, hit him with Sylas W Kingslayer and finish with an attack, using your passive charge in the trade.
Xerath.escape: The opportunity to engage comes as soon as Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down.
Xerath.fight: As soon as Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer. While Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, dodge to the side as you approach the slowed Xerath. After taking damage, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and keep trading.
Xerath.laning: Farm while dodging Xerath’s heavy damage, and even when using Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions, save the skills and mana you need to trade. When Xerath spends mana and his poke weakens, push the lane and get help from your jungler.
Xerath.phase: In the late game, look for a position where you can use a stolen ultimate effectively instead of diving in first from the front.
Xerath.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack, and prioritize stealing an area crowd control or engage ultimate from another opponent if possible. After your allies engage, go in second with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. In a skirmish, hit an enemy champion with Sylas W Kingslayer the moment health is reduced to heal and stay alive.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you’re likely to get hit by several follow-up attacks, so make a point of dodging that one. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so move far to the side when you see him charging it. Watch out for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction, and when you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begin casting, dodge immediately or engage while Xerath can’t move.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If you get an attack speed slow, you can delay both Yasuo’s basic attacks and the return of his tornado.
Yasuo.combo: Use an empowered attack, place the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Yasuo, then attack. When health has been reduced, hit him with Sylas W Kingslayer and follow with another empowered attack.
Yasuo.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Look to engage with the knockup from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct even before Yasuo R Last Breath is back up. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t engage just because he used it once.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to break the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer, then trade in earnest once it’s gone. Close in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or immediately after Yasuo throws it. After health has been reduced, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and on your side of the lane to reduce the paths Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.phase: In the late game, account for Sylas’s short range and squishiness and choose fights where a stolen ultimate can be valuable.
Yasuo.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. After an ally’s engage ability hits, go in second with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Prioritize ultimates that help with area crowd control or engaging. In a skirmish, hit an enemy champion with Sylas W Kingslayer the moment health is reduced to stay alive.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge when Yasuo approaches. After he hits it twice, his next Q launches a tornado that knocks you up, so watch for the sound and visual effect and prepare to dodge. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, save key skills or go around the wall.

Yone.combo: Then use Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → empowered attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → empowered attack. Place the delayed intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash under Yone while he’s knocked up.
Yone.escape: Don’t rush to engage when only one of Yone’s mobility abilities is unavailable; he still has other options. In particular, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up, close the gap with Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct.
Yone.fight: After health has been reduced during a trade, hit the champion with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal. Don’t engage just because one of Yone’s mobility abilities is unavailable; look especially for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up.
Yone.laning: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, keep your distance and watch for his tornado.
Yone.phase: In the late game, you can struggle in head-on fights, so look for a situation where a stolen ultimate can make an impact.
Yone.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. After your allies engage, follow up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave can’t hit multiple champions and grow its shield. If health is reduced by Yone’s attacks while he is in spirit form, heal with Sylas W Kingslayer or get out of range before the additional damage arrives when he returns.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, wait out of range for the stacks to expire. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so check your position and engage route just before a teamfight.

Zed.build: Zed’s main damage is physical, so build armor early. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Zed.combo: Use an empowered attack → Sylas Q Chain Lash → attack → Sylas W Kingslayer → attack.
Zed.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Zed W Living Shadow alone is unavailable. The opening comes after Zed has also used Zed R Death Mark, especially before that ultimate comes back up. Get out of the slow area from Zed E Shadow Slash, then close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer.
Zed.fight: After Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, start trading once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already swapped positions with it. Knock him up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, weave empowered attacks between skills, then hit Zed with Sylas W Kingslayer after health has been reduced to heal. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and Zed tends to have low magic resistance, so you can damage him in this trade.
Zed.laning: After learning Sylas R Hijack, push the lane and join fights in other lanes or around objectives.
Zed.phase: Zed gets weaker in the late game, but head-on fights also become difficult for Sylas, so move around with your allies and look for a situation where you can use a stolen ultimate.
Zed.teamfight: Before a fight, secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack. After your allies engage, follow up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. When Zed engages with Zed R Death Mark, knock him up with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct so he can’t build up more damage while the mark is active. In a skirmish, if health is reduced, hit an enemy champion such as Zed with Sylas W Kingslayer to heal and stay alive.
Zed.watch: Watch out for the physical damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Watch the shadows and move out of the slow area from Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark is on you, interrupt Zed’s follow-up damage with the knockup from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct.

Zoe.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of the way of Zoe’s telegraphed attacks. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance against Zoe’s magic damage, but you must withstand the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble with your health pool.
Zoe.combo: Use E Abscond / Abduct’s knock-up to place Q Chain Lash’s delayed-explosion intersection beneath Zoe.
Zoe.escape: Engage while Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down or Zoe R Portal Jump is down. If Zoe uses R Portal Jump, she must return to her starting point, so you can target that spot.
Zoe.fight: As soon as Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close the gap with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and W Kingslayer. Weave Sylas P Petricite Burst empowered attacks between abilities, and hit Zoe with W Kingslayer to heal after health has been reduced during the trade.
Zoe.laning: Use Sylas Q Chain Lash to clear minions while saving abilities for trades, and avoid the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble if it misses.
Zoe.phase: In the late game, look for a valuable opportunity to use your stolen ultimate instead of diving in first from the front.
Zoe.teamfight: Secure an ultimate to use with Sylas R Hijack before the fight, then go in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct after your allies engage. Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, stick to Zoe with Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct. In a chaotic fight, hit Zoe with W Kingslayer the moment health is reduced to heal and keep fighting.
Zoe.watch: Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble puts you to sleep after a short delay, leaving you vulnerable to Zoe’s attacks while asleep. Dodge the bubble; if it hits you, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star! You can interrupt Zoe as she tries to redirect Q Paddle Star! with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s knock-up.
